Several images in one drag, choices in your snippets, image touch-ups, and your Maccy history.

- **Several images, one drag or one paste.** Pick images in the shelf with ⌘-click and drag them into a chat, a mail or a web page: each one arrives as its own file, where a drop used to merge them. Pasted into a web page, or an app like Slack, ChatGPT or Claude, they go in one after the other, since such a page takes only one image per paste. Text picked along with them goes first.
- **Told when something stays behind.** A web page takes only the text of a mixed drop, and one file per paste. When that happens, a short message over your app says what was left out, and how to add it.
- **Choices in snippets.** `{{title:Mr|Ms}}` becomes a menu in the snippet form, the first choice selected, and `{{city:Paris}}` a field already filled in.
- **Touch up an image.** Right-click an image: Reduce by half, Fit within 1920 pixels, Convert to JPEG or PNG, or Remove metadata and location. Each makes a new copy, without the original's metadata; the original stays as it was.
- **Import from Maccy.** Settings → Data → Import from Maccy… brings Maccy's history into encore, pinned items as favorites, under the same rules as your own copies. Maccy's data is only read.
- **Fixed.** Copy and paste sounds no longer freeze encore. With an audio output slow to wake up, like a screen over HDMI or DisplayPort, Bluetooth headphones or AirPlay, a copy or a paste could hang encore for a second or two. The sound now plays on its own, and is skipped rather than played late.

Download the ZIP, unzip, and move Encore.app to Applications. SHA256SUMS contains its checksum. Installed copies update themselves.

encore is not notarized yet. [Apple's first-launch instructions](https://support.apple.com/en-us/102445). History encryption is optional and off by default; exports are not encrypted; files are references; embedded payloads are limited to 25 MiB.
